{{Quote|The alleged ringmaster of these activities&mdash;dubbed the 'Master of Ceremonies'&mdash;has somehow obtained an official license to peddle his 'holiday cheer' in the Galactic Trade Market sector of Vaiken Spacedock.|Extract from Imperial Edict GR-1NC4|<ref name="Holonet">{{TORweb|url=info/news/blog/20131216|text=IMPERIAL EDICT GR-1NC4}}</ref>}}
The '''Master of Ceremonies''' was the nickname of a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who organized [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] activities towards the middle of the [[inter-Sith Wars period]]. In [[3638 BBY]], he and his [[Life Day Revelers]] stayed on [[Vaiken Spacedock]], which was property of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. However, the Imperials had only allowed him on their spacedock by accident, and his presence was explicitely condemned in the [[Imperial Edict GR-1NC4]]. During his two-[[Standard week/Legends|week]] stay on the spacedock, the Master of Ceremonies sold festive goods and promoted cheerful activities that were looked at with jaundiced [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] by the Imperial authorities. That same year, he also appeared on [[Carrick Station]], with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] blessing.

==Biography==
{{Quote|It has come to the Empire's attention that dissident elements engaging in a tawdry and potentially dangerous seasonal event are planning to infect Imperial space with their insipid notions.|Extract from Imperial Edict GR-1NC4|<ref name="Holonet" />}}
[[File:Life_Day_revelers.png|thumb|left|The Master of Ceremonies led the Life Day Revelers.]]
The [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] known as the "Master of Ceremonies" lived during the [[inter-Sith Wars period]]. With the help of his [[Life Day Revelers]], he promoted the celebration of [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]],<ref name="Holonet" /> an end-of-the-year holiday originally invented by the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]],<ref name="blog">{{WebCite|url=https://www.clonewarsadventures.com/news/detail.action?articleId=1126|text=Life Day returns!|work=Intergalactic News|archivedate=20111208024549}}</ref> in the wider [[galactic community]]. By [[3638 BBY]], in the midst of the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], he acted as the ringmaster of a series of seasonal activities revolving around the celebration of Life Day. Along with his entourage of Human and Wookiee Revelers, the Master of Ceremonies showed up at both the Republic's [[Carrick Station]] and the Empire's [[Vaiken Spacedock]] to bring holiday cheer and sell Life Day-themed novelty items.<ref name="Holonet" />

While the Galactic Republic welcomed the Revelers on Carrick Station, the authorities of the Sith Empire considered their holiday activities to be "unbecoming of an Imperial citizen." Despite that, the Master of Ceremonies did obtain an official license to peddle his goods in the [[Star Wars: The Old Republic|Galactic Trade Market]] sector of Vaiken Spacedock because of an administrative oversight. The Master of Ceremonies and his Revelers remained on Vaiken Spacedock for two [[Standard week/Legends|weeks]], encouraging the Imperials stationed there to sing, dance and throw harmless [[Life Day snowball bomb]]s at each other. Despite having accidentally authorized him on the station, the Imperial government issued the [[Imperial Edict GR-1NC4]], branding the Master of Ceremonies and his cohorts as dissident elements. The edict also warned the citizens not to buy their goods&mdash;which were under review under [[Section 53-T]] of Imperial law, meaning their purchase and possession was be considered an official contraband violation.<ref name="Holonet" />

==Personality and traits==
By 3638 BBY, the Master of Ceremonies was a tall, husky man with broad shoulders, brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and a pinkish complexion. Most of his once brown [[Hair/Legends|hair]] had gone white with the exception of the eyebrows, and he sported a short boxed beard. When selling his holiday items on Vaiken Spacedock, he [[Clothing/Legends|wore]] the same red [[Robe/Legends|robes]] and white [[Glove/Legends|gloves]] of the Life Day Revelers, while also donning a distinctive crescent-shaped headgear with a crest mounted transversely.<ref name="TOR" />

Contrary to the dominant position in the Sith Empire, the Master of Ceremonies had no biases against non-Humans such as the Wookiees, the original celebrants of Life Day on their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of Kashyyyk, as he openly encouraged nonviolent physical contact with them. As a whole, his cheerful disposition put him at odds with the Imperial culture, which was dominated by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] and soldiers.<ref name="Holonet" />
